name: acf-tools
description: ACF Cognitive Toolkit - Specialized cognitive modes for Agentic Continuous Flow workflows including reasoning validation, production verification, knowledge validation, and complexity navigation

plugins.name: acf-challenger-mode
plugins.description: Reasoning validation mode - Intellectually aggressive challenger who attacks every gap in logic and consistency. Perfect for requirements clarification, architecture review, and agent output validation.

plugins.name: acf-arazor-mode
plugins.description: Production verification mode - Ruthless honesty enforcer with zero tolerance for false production claims. Binary outcomes only. Perfect for deployment readiness checks and status reporting.

plugins.name: acf-librarian
plugins.description: Convention enforcement mode - The stern librarian enforces ACF naming and organization standards through context injection. Auto-initializes docs/acf/organization.md, audits compliance, and ensures everything stays in its proper place.

plugins.name: acf-whip
plugins.description: Workflow-native backlog automation with per-task authored child workflows. /task decomposes a scope into atomic, dependency-aware tasks; /go runs each unit as its OWN nested multi-agent workflow — a harness a workflow-architect agent fills into a locked, validated skeleton — in isolated git worktrees (one per slug), then reviews and integrates via LP-CAS, looping until every task is accepted or blocked. A bare /go runs your FOCUS: the tasks /task just created, or the ones you selected with /whip-focus — so the ordinary path needs no arguments and still runs only your own work, while /go --all drains the whole backlog and /go <ids|MUL-1234|a natural-language filter> runs exactly what you name. On a shared board a bare /go with no focus refuses rather than draining everyone's queue. The snapshot is narrowed in the STORE (--only emits just the closure of the named tasks) and carries a relay header the orchestrator verifies, so a large board can no longer be silently truncated on its way through a scan agent and reported back as missing task ids. An integrity FATAL now holds out the ONE task it names instead of stopping the run, so a single malformed card cannot block a whole team; runs that hold something out report partial, never complete. Pausing is a real state on every backend (/whip-move <task> draft, archive to cancel), and doctor --fix never overwrites a hold a human set. Agents route by tier — cheap for the fixed-command shell runners, the project's declared per-agent model for specialists and reviewers — and every run reports which tier spent what. Task state lives behind an executable adapter contract: .backlog/ files (default), beads, multica, or Linear. Integration is a compare-and-swap of a single-parent candidate onto the live trunk with an in-tree ledger marker as the sole oracle. Concurrency-safe and self-healing via /whip-doctor.

plugins.name: acf-nitro
plugins.description: Parallel execution enforcement mode - Enthusiastic speed demon who catches sequential execution violations and calculates time waste. Enforces TodoWrite batching, parallel Task spawning, and parallel tool calls.

plugins.name: acf-mission-control
plugins.description: Two-line status line HUD: 1M-aware fuel gauge, self-priced session cost (incl. subagents), rate limits, cache warmth; themeable glyphs; self-upgrading

plugins.name: acf-advisor
plugins.description: Two skills for second opinions: `advisor` consults another LLM (thinking on by default) for one focused take; `board` convenes a multi-persona panel hypertailored to the decision, run as parallel advisor.py calls and synthesized by the orchestrator with weighting on the user-chosen priority dimension. Calls any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; comma-delimited ADVISOR_MODEL declares a multi-model pool for round-robin or cross-model triangulation. Per-family param-shape routing (Claude adaptive, Gemini thinking_level, OpenAI reasoning_effort) with ADVISOR_PROFILE override and shape-swap retry. Falls back to a local-team mode (Claude subagents roleplay personas) when no endpoint is configured.
